t: Three things forbidden and three disliked
a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَمَنْعَ وَهَاتِ، وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ، وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ
p: Inna-Llāha ḥarrama ʿalaykum ʿuqūqa-l-ummahāt, wa manʿa wa hāt, wa waʾda-l-banāt, wa kariha lakum qīla wa qāl
m: Allah has forbidden you undutifulness to mothers, withholding and demanding, and burying daughters alive. And He dislikes for you idle talk,
